name: Moving Momentum: SMA20/150 bias, Stochastic pullback, MACD-histogram turn
author: StockCharts ChartSchool
license: StockCharts ChartSchool educational text; paraphrased, not copied
instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
entry_long: SMA(20) > SMA(150) (bullish bias); Stochastic oscillator drops below 20 (pullback); then buy when MACD-Histogram turns positive.
entry_short: SMA(20) < SMA(150); Stochastic rises above 80 (bounce); sell short when MACD-Histogram turns negative.
exit: Exit rule is not given mechanically (trade management left to chartist); reverse bias or histogram turning negative is the implied exit.
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Entry fully explicit; exit missing => incomplete.
